headword: {有限会社|ゆうげんがいしゃ}

definitions.explanation: A type of Japanese small-business corporation in which the owners' liability is limited to their investment. New {有限会社|ゆうげんがいしゃ} cannot be founded since the 2006 Companies Act, but existing ones continue to operate and the name is still common in business listings.

examples.japanese: {父|ちち}は{有限会社|ゆうげんがいしゃ}を{経営|けいえい}している。
examples.english: My father runs a limited liability company.

examples.japanese: {名刺|めいし}には{有限会社|ゆうげんがいしゃ}の{社名|しゃめい}が{書|か}かれていた。
examples.english: The business card had the name of a limited liability company on it.

examples.japanese: {制度|せいど}が{変|か}わったため、{新|あら}たに{有限会社|ゆうげんがいしゃ}を{設立|せつりつ}することはできない。
examples.english: Because the law changed, it is no longer possible to newly establish a limited liability company.

notes:
Often abbreviated {有限|ゆうげん} or written as ㈲ before the company name. The 2006 Companies Act ({会社法|かいしゃほう}) discontinued the category, but existing {有限会社|ゆうげんがいしゃ} were grandfathered in and may still keep the title indefinitely.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {有限会社|ゆうげんがいしゃ}を{設立|せつりつ}する: to establish a limited company
- {有限会社|ゆうげんがいしゃ}を{経営|けいえい}する: to run a limited company
- {有限会社|ゆうげんがいしゃ}{○○|まるまる}: "○○ Ltd." (in company names)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {株式会社|かぶしきがいしゃ}: stock company; joint-stock corporation — much larger and more common form, with shares
- {合同会社|ごうどうがいしゃ}: LLC (Japanese-style) — the modern small-business form that replaced {有限会社|ゆうげんがいしゃ} after 2006
